definition: The sky, especially when imagined as a vast covering overhead.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: Before him and behind: above, below, on the right and on the left: he seemed to stand surrounded by a firmament, all bright with gleaming eyes.
example_sentence: Stars crowded the firmament above the campsite.
